title: Secrets, Providers, and Tool Governance
goal: Govern secrets, provider eligibility, model access, tool contracts, budgets, approvals, and evidence before any live external execution can be considered.
userImpact: Founders and operators get a clear enterprise provider/tool governance path without fake live actions or hidden spend.
commandCenterImpact: P136.2 preserves current Command Center UX and provides the read-only model P136.4 can later surface.
safetyImpact: Secret values, provider calls, model calls, tool execution, MCP server startup, agent dispatch, DB/runtime writes, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and spend remain blocked.
costImpact: No provider, model, network, DB service, deployment, export, package, or tool execution spend.

subphases.title: Contract / Policy / Safety Boundary
subphases.narrowGoal: Start P136 with an implementation-grade secrets/provider/tool governance contract, seven-subphase split, safety boundary, checker, docs/status handoff, and planned-only P136.2 handoff.
subphases.dataShape: Contract-only. Adds no secret values, secret stores, provider adapters, tool executors, model clients, budget ledgers, approval writers, dashboard source, Playwright source, DB/runtime writers, or live execution paths.
subphases.commandCenterUx: Preserve existing Command Center UX. P136.1 does not edit dashboard source, labels, controls, routes, or theme behavior. P136.4 owns future scoped Provider Governance UX changes.
themeRequirements: Validate through existing route-wide Command Center Playwright coverage.
safetyRules: Do not create, read, print, persist, rotate, validate, or expose secret values in P136.1.
Do not connect providers, call models, call external APIs, use network calls, or spend in P136.1.
Do not execute tools, start MCP servers, run workers, dispatch agents, mutate projects, or write DB/runtime state in P136.1.
Do not create provider credentials, model clients, tool executors, budget ledgers, approval writers, deploy paths, release paths, export paths, or package paths in P136.1.

Do not expose raw private IDs, raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, secret references as primary identifiers, provider payloads, mutation controls, provider controls, tool execution controls, deploy controls, package controls, or spend controls in primary UX.
reuseCheck: Reuse existing secrets boundary, provider preview, tool governance, budget, and approval artifacts as evidence only.
Reuse existing OS phase status and roadmap structures.
Do not duplicate report writers, checker formatters, redaction helpers, mode guards, result envelopes, route matrices, or activity/evidence appenders.
